title: Resolution urging Albany to pass the BUILD Act for immigrant legal aid
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.2689/S.4538, the Building Up Immigrant Legal Defense (BUILD) Act. The bill would create competitive grants to help organizations expand immigration legal representation by building their workforce and legal services capacity. Supporters say the funding is needed as demand for immigration legal help in New York City has grown sharply amid increased federal immigration enforcement.
